purpose: Canonical contributor, bot, automation, and AI-agent identity registry for repository provenance. Direct contribution credit requires Git identity or explicit commit trailers; operational surfaces and user-declared tools are tracked separately.

semantics.direct_contribution: Count only Git author/committer identity or an explicit direct-contribution trailer. A tool name in prose, a model catalog, instruction file, branch name, or snapshot path is not direct authorship evidence.
semantics.operational_surface: An instruction file, workflow, branch/snapshot name, or commit-message reference proves repository interaction/surface only, not authorship of code.
semantics.user_declared: Records a tool the repository owner reports using; it is not attached to individual commits unless direct repository evidence exists.
semantics.unknown_identity: Unmatched identities remain separate. Heuristics may classify bot-like names but must not alias them to a named service without evidence.
semantics.history_rewrites: Squash merges, rebases, cherry-picks, imported snapshots, and rewritten commits can collapse or duplicate attribution. The index reports observable Git evidence and never reconstructs missing authorship by guesswork.
semantics.privacy: Generated provenance outputs do not emit raw email addresses. Matching may use Git emails locally; unknown identities receive stable hashed IDs.
